name: Chandni Chowk Restaurant
why_it_matters: The pure-veg multi-cuisine canteen at the southern corner where Mall Road meets Tallital — themed after Old Delhi's Chandni Chowk and built around a long chaat-and-sweets counter. The hot jalebis off the kadai are the dish locals come for; everything else is filler.
insider_tip: Eat the jalebi standing at the counter, not seated upstairs — the seated rate is higher and the jalebis cool by the time they reach the table.

name: New Sher E Punjab
why_it_matters: The Tallital-end Punjabi joint that catches travellers off the bus before they walk into Mall Road proper. Same family that ran the older Sher-e-Punjab in Mallital — this one is the second-generation branch. Tandoor-driven menu, lake-side seating, Jain options on request.
insider_tip: There are two Sher-e-Punjabs in Nainital — this is the Tallital one near the bus stand. Don't confuse with the Gari Parao branch on the Mallital side. Open 9-4 and 6:30-10:30 with an afternoon break.

name: Simz Cafe
why_it_matters: Owner Simran Bisht runs this small glass-fronted cafe at the junction where Tallital's Mall Road meets Thandi Sadak — quiet end of the lake, away from the Mallital crush. Books, UNO and chess on the tables; the pastry counter is the strongest part of the menu.
insider_tip: Walk in, not drive in — the parking near Tallital Bus Stand is a 4-minute uphill walk from the cafe. Window seats look directly onto Naini Lake; ask for the corner table by the glass.
signature_address: 156, Anand Complex, Thandi Sadak, Tallital, Nainital 263002

name: Vaishnav Bhojanalya
why_it_matters: The cheapest honest thali within walking distance of Tallital Bus Stand — pure-veg, no onion-no garlic options on request, ₹200-for-two pricing that hasn't moved much in years. Where bus drivers, taxi unions and budget pilgrims eat before the climb to Naina Devi.
insider_tip: Lunch goes 12-3pm and the thali rotation is freshest then; evening service drops to a la carte. The shop is at #17 on Haldwani Road, not on Mall Road proper.
signature_address: Shop 17, Haldwani Road, near Bus Station, Tallital, Nainital 263001

name: Variety Restaurant
why_it_matters: Working-class North Indian + Indo-Chinese kitchen at Tikonia Chauraha (the three-way junction by the Tallital police station). Not a destination dinner — but a reliable, ₹500-for-two stop after a long bus journey or before catching the morning service back to Haldwani.
insider_tip: Stick to Indo-Chinese — the Punjabi side is patchy. The momos here are an after-thought; for momos, walk up Mall Road to the Tibetan stalls instead.
signature_address: Near Tikonia Chauraha, near Police Station, Tallital, Nainital 263002

name: Shiwalik Restaurant
why_it_matters: Old-school Tallital market restaurant inside the cluster of shops opposite the bus stand — not a Mall Road tourist trap, more a daily lunch stop for shopkeepers and KMVN guests. Sambhar-paneer-noodle rotation, no view, no frills.
insider_tip: Skip Mall Road's premium for the same dishes — Shiwalik's paneer tikka masala lands at half the Mall Road rate. No alcohol, no terrace; eat fast and move on.
